# Fatigue_SpikePattern

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Distinct temporal spike firing patterns in SNNs that correlate with muscle fatigue progression, extracted from sEMG-derived spike trains. Provides a robust neural signature for fatigue detection that is more energy-efficient than traditional continuous signal processing.
